title: How Spotify’s AI-Driven Recommendations Work | WSJ Tech Behind
speaker: The Wall Street Journal
zh: 【The Wall Street Journal】Spotify 的人工智慧驅動推薦如何運作 |華爾街日報技術背後（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: With 500 million monthly users, Spotify is the world's largest music streaming service.
cues.en: With 500 million monthly users, Spotify is the world's largest music streaming service.
cues.zh: Spotify 每月擁有 5 億使用者，是全球最大的音樂串流服務。

cues.text: is the home of audio.
cues.en: is the home of audio.
cues.zh: 是音響之家。

cues.text: It's known for its personalized playlists, made with its recommendation algorithm.
cues.en: It's known for its personalized playlists, made with its recommendation algorithm.
cues.zh: 它以其推薦演演算法製作的個人化播放清單而聞名。

cues.text: Think about users as this raw material, and then on top of the data layer,
cues.en: Think about users as this raw material, and then on top of the data layer,
cues.zh: 將使用者視為原料，然後在資料層之上，

cues.text: we're able to build shared models.
cues.en: we're able to build shared models.
cues.zh: 我們能夠建立共享模型。

cues.text: But relying so much on artificial intelligence has also drawn criticism
cues.en: But relying so much on artificial intelligence has also drawn criticism
cues.zh: 但過度依賴人工智慧也招致批評

cues.text: from some industry experts worried about algorithmic bias.
cues.en: from some industry experts worried about algorithmic bias.
cues.zh: 一些行業專家擔心演演算法偏差。

cues.text: Here's how Spotify uses AI to personalize users experiences on the platform.
cues.en: Here's how Spotify uses AI to personalize users experiences on the platform.
cues.zh: 以下是 Spotify 如何使用人工智慧來個人化平臺上的使用者體驗。

cues.text: This is the tech behind Spotify.
cues.en: This is the tech behind Spotify.
cues.zh: 這就是 Spotify 背後的技術。

cues.text: In the early two thousands, many people found music recommendations through top charts
cues.en: In the early two thousands, many people found music recommendations through top charts
cues.zh: 兩千出頭，很多人透過熱門排行榜找到音樂推薦

cues.text: and early streaming platforms like Pandora and Last.fm.
cues.en: and early streaming platforms like Pandora and Last.fm.
cues.zh: 以及 Pandora 和 Last.fm 等早期串流媒體平臺。

cues.text: With the Last.fm app from the App Store, you can listen to great bands.
cues.en: With the Last.fm app from the App Store, you can listen to great bands.
cues.zh: 透過 App Store 中的 Last.fm 應用程式，您可以聆聽精彩樂團的音樂。

cues.text: So, when Spotify entered the scene in 2008.
cues.en: So, when Spotify entered the scene in 2008.
cues.zh: 所以，當 Spotify 在 2008 年進入現場時。

cues.text: It's not so much that they the first people to start using analytics to recommend music,
cues.en: It's not so much that they the first people to start using analytics to recommend music,
cues.zh: 並不是說他們是第一批開始使用分析來推薦音樂的人，

cues.text: but it was the way in which they combined various computational techniques
cues.en: but it was the way in which they combined various computational techniques
cues.zh: 但這是他們結合各種計算技術的方式

cues.text: in order to make their recommendations feel more lifelike.
cues.en: in order to make their recommendations feel more lifelike.
cues.zh: 為了讓他們的推薦感覺更逼真。

cues.text: Thomas Hodgson studies algorithms and artificial intelligence with a focus on how new technology
cues.en: Thomas Hodgson studies algorithms and artificial intelligence with a focus on how new technology
cues.zh: 霍奇森（Thomas Hodgson）研究演演算法和人工智慧，重點關注新技術如何

cues.text: from music streaming companies impact artists.
cues.en: from music streaming companies impact artists.
cues.zh: 來自音樂串流媒體公司的影響藝術家。

cues.text: Fans who have listened to Discover Weekly and Daily Mix.
cues.en: Fans who have listened to Discover Weekly and Daily Mix.
cues.zh: 聽過 Discover Weekly 和 Daily Mix 的粉絲。

cues.text: The way that they talk about them is in very human-like terms.
cues.en: The way that they talk about them is in very human-like terms.
cues.zh: 他們談論這些事情的方式非常人性化。

cues.text: Discover Weekly, you magnificent.
cues.en: Discover Weekly, you magnificent.
cues.zh: 發現週刊，你太棒了。

cues.text: You've done it again.
cues.en: You've done it again.
cues.zh: 你又做到了。

cues.text: In 2014, Spotify acquired music analytics firm The Echo Nest,
cues.en: In 2014, Spotify acquired music analytics firm The Echo Nest,
cues.zh: 2014年，Spotify收購了音樂分析公司The Echo Nest，

cues.text: which blended machine learning and natural language processing to build a database of songs and artists.
cues.en: which blended machine learning and natural language processing to build a database of songs and artists.
cues.zh: 它融合了機器學習和自然語言處理來建立歌曲和藝術家的資料庫。

cues.text: Spotify says this technology marked an important step in the evolution of its recommendation system.
cues.en: Spotify says this technology marked an important step in the evolution of its recommendation system.
cues.zh: Spotify 表示，這項技術標誌著其推薦系統的發展邁出了重要一步。

cues.text: So, how does that system work?
cues.en: So, how does that system work?
cues.zh: 那麼，這個系統是如何運作的呢？

cues.text: It starts with a process called collaborative filtering.
cues.en: It starts with a process called collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 它始於一個稱為協同過濾的過程。

cues.text: Collaborative filtering looks at the pattern, across all of this data and tries to understand
cues.en: Collaborative filtering looks at the pattern, across all of this data and tries to understand
cues.zh: 協作過濾著眼於所有這些資料的模式並嘗試理解

cues.text: when do tracks happen to be playlisted together very often?
cues.en: when do tracks happen to be playlisted together very often?
cues.zh: 什麼時候曲目會常常一起播放？

cues.text: You can think of it as building a map of music and podcast.
cues.en: You can think of it as building a map of music and podcast.
cues.zh: 您可以將其視為構建音樂和播客地圖。

cues.text: That map looks something like this.
cues.en: That map looks something like this.
cues.zh: 那張地圖看起來像這樣。

cues.text: Each point represents a different track in Spotify's catalog
cues.en: Each point represents a different track in Spotify's catalog
cues.zh: 每個點代表 Spotify 目錄中的不同曲目

cues.text: and the location of each point is determined by collaborative filtering.
cues.en: and the location of each point is determined by collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 透過協同過濾來確定每個點的位置。

cues.text: Which means that these tracks go together, according to the way users have playlisted them
cues.en: Which means that these tracks go together, according to the way users have playlisted them
cues.zh: 這意味著這些曲目根據使用者播放清單的方式組合在一起

cues.text: and listened to them.
cues.en: and listened to them.
cues.zh: 並聽取了他們的意見。

cues.text: So, if these two songs, are frequently playlisted together they will be close to each other in this map.
cues.en: So, if these two songs, are frequently playlisted together they will be close to each other in this map.
cues.zh: 因此，如果這兩首歌曲經常一起播放，那麼它們在這張地圖上就會彼此接近。

cues.text: Whereas if these songs are never playlisted together they will be farther apart in the map.
cues.en: Whereas if these songs are never playlisted together they will be farther apart in the map.
cues.zh: 然而，如果這些歌曲從未一起播放列表，它們在地圖上的距離就會更遠。

cues.text: But recommendations based purely on collaborative filtering aren't perfect.
cues.en: But recommendations based purely on collaborative filtering aren't perfect.
cues.zh: 但純粹基於協同過濾的推薦並不完美。

cues.text: For example, during the holidays, Mariah Carey's "All I want for Christmas is You,"
cues.en: For example, during the holidays, Mariah Carey's "All I want for Christmas is You,"
cues.zh: 例如，假期期間，瑪麗亞凱莉的“聖誕節我想要的就是你”，

cues.text: might get playlisted more frequently with "Silent Night," Even though this sounds like a pop song.
cues.en: might get playlisted more frequently with "Silent Night," Even though this sounds like a pop song.
cues.zh: 「平安夜」可能會更頻繁地出現在播放清單中，儘管這聽起來像是一首流行歌曲。

cues.text: ♪ Baby all I want for Christmas is you ♪
cues.en: ♪ Baby all I want for Christmas is you ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 寶貝，聖誕節我想要的就是你 ♪

cues.text: And this sounds like a Christmas Carol.
cues.en: And this sounds like a Christmas Carol.
cues.zh: 這聽起來像聖誕頌歌。

cues.text: ♪ Silent night ♪ If Spotify only generated recommendations,
cues.en: ♪ Silent night ♪ If Spotify only generated recommendations,
cues.zh: ♪ 平安夜 ♪ 若 Spotify 只產生推薦，

cues.text: based on proximity, then users who like Mariah Carey, might get recommended "Silent Night"
cues.en: based on proximity, then users who like Mariah Carey, might get recommended "Silent Night"
cues.zh: 基於鄰近度，那麼喜歡瑪麗亞凱莉的使用者可能會被推薦“平安夜”

cues.text: when they aren't interested in Christmas Carols.
cues.en: when they aren't interested in Christmas Carols.
cues.zh: 當他們對聖誕頌歌不感興趣時。

cues.text: To prevent this, Spotify adds another layer of analysis, called content-based filtering.
cues.en: To prevent this, Spotify adds another layer of analysis, called content-based filtering.
cues.zh: 為了防止這種情況，Spotify 新增了另一層分析，稱為基於內容的過濾。

cues.text: This algorithm gathers metadata like the release date and label and executes a raw audio analysis.
cues.en: This algorithm gathers metadata like the release date and label and executes a raw audio analysis.
cues.zh: 該演演算法收集發布日期和標籤等後設資料，並執行原始音訊分析。

cues.text: It uses metrics like dance ability and loudness to describe the sonic characteristics of the track.
cues.en: It uses metrics like dance ability and loudness to describe the sonic characteristics of the track.
cues.zh: 它使用舞蹈能力和響度等指標來描述曲目的聲音特徵。

cues.text: These are the results for "Uptown Funk" which sounds like this.
cues.en: These are the results for "Uptown Funk" which sounds like this.
cues.zh: 這些是「Uptown Funk」的結果，聽起來像這樣。

cues.text: ♪ This hit, that ice cold ♪ ♪ Michelle Pfeiffer, that white gold ♪
cues.en: ♪ This hit, that ice cold ♪ ♪ Michelle Pfeiffer, that white gold ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 這一擊，冰冷 ♪ ♪ 米歇爾‧菲佛，白金 ♪

cues.text: And has the Dance Ability score of 0.856 on a scale of zero to one.
cues.en: And has the Dance Ability score of 0.856 on a scale of zero to one.
cues.zh: 舞蹈能力得分為 0.856（從 0 到 1）。

cues.text: The algorithm also dissects each track's temporal structure.
cues.en: The algorithm also dissects each track's temporal structure.
cues.zh: 該演演算法還剖析每個軌道的時間結構。

cues.text: Here's the visual representation of that for "Anti-Hero" by Taylor Swift.
cues.en: Here's the visual representation of that for "Anti-Hero" by Taylor Swift.
cues.zh: 這是泰勒絲的《反英雄》的視覺表現。

cues.text: These are the beats, the bars and the sections.
cues.en: These are the beats, the bars and the sections.
cues.zh: 這些是節拍、小節和片段。

cues.text: Content-based filtering also takes into account attracts cultural context
cues.en: Content-based filtering also takes into account attracts cultural context
cues.zh: 基於內容的過濾也考慮了吸引的文化背景

cues.text: which means studying the lyrics and analyzing the adjectives used to describe the track in articles and blogs.
cues.en: which means studying the lyrics and analyzing the adjectives used to describe the track in articles and blogs.
cues.zh: 這意味著研究歌詞並分析文章和部落格中用於描述歌曲的形容詞。

cues.text: These filtering techniques are not unique to Spotify, but industry experts say what sets the platform apart
cues.en: These filtering techniques are not unique to Spotify, but industry experts say what sets the platform apart
cues.zh: 這些過濾技術並非 Spotify 所獨有，但產業專家表示該平臺的與眾不同之處

cues.text: is the amount of user data it has and the products it creates from it.
cues.en: is the amount of user data it has and the products it creates from it.
cues.zh: 是它擁有的使用者資料量以及它根據這些資料建立的產品的數量。

cues.text: Spotify says its content based filtering technology has evolved over the years
cues.en: Spotify says its content based filtering technology has evolved over the years
cues.zh: Spotify 表示其基於內容的過濾技術多年來已經不斷發展

cues.text: and now includes more advanced proprietary facing features.
cues.en: and now includes more advanced proprietary facing features.
cues.zh: 現在包括更先進的專有面向功能。

cues.text: But Hodgson says the danger with algorithms is that they could reinforce existing biases.
cues.en: But Hodgson says the danger with algorithms is that they could reinforce existing biases.
cues.zh: 但霍奇森表示，演演算法的危險在於它們可能強化現有的偏見。

cues.text: This could mean that a particular catalog of music has more male artists than female artists.
cues.en: This could mean that a particular catalog of music has more male artists than female artists.
cues.zh: 這可能意味著特定音樂目錄中的男性藝術家多於女性藝術家。

cues.text: One of the dangers with machine learning is that as listeners start to engage
cues.en: One of the dangers with machine learning is that as listeners start to engage
cues.zh: 機器學習的危險之一是當聽眾開始參與時

cues.text: with that catalog those biases become magnified and that this creates what's called a kind of feedback loop.
cues.en: with that catalog those biases become magnified and that this creates what's called a kind of feedback loop.
cues.zh: 有了這個目錄，這些偏見就會被放大，這會產生所謂的回饋迴圈。

cues.text: Spotify says it's research teams evaluate and mitigate against potential algorithmic inequities
cues.en: Spotify says it's research teams evaluate and mitigate against potential algorithmic inequities
cues.zh: Spotify 表示，其研究團隊正在評估和減輕潛在的演演算法不平等問題

cues.text: and harms and strive for transparency about its impact.
cues.en: and harms and strive for transparency about its impact.
cues.zh: 並努力使其影響透明化。

cues.text: Another criticism is that the algorithm isn't optimized for new artists because there's no user data.
cues.en: Another criticism is that the algorithm isn't optimized for new artists because there's no user data.
cues.zh: 另一個批評是該演演算法沒有針對新藝術家進行最佳化，因為沒有使用者資料。

cues.text: This is known as the cold start problem.
cues.en: This is known as the cold start problem.
cues.zh: 這稱為冷啟動問題。

cues.text: Sultan says this is where human editors, play a significant role in delivering recommendations.
cues.en: Sultan says this is where human editors, play a significant role in delivering recommendations.
cues.zh: 蘇丹說，這就是人類編輯在提供推薦方面發揮重要作用的地方。

cues.text: They're possibly some of the best people in the world at trying to understand new releases
cues.en: They're possibly some of the best people in the world at trying to understand new releases
cues.zh: 他們可能是世界上最擅長嘗試理解新版本的人之一

cues.text: and culture and what's relevant.
cues.en: and culture and what's relevant.
cues.zh: 和文化以及相關的內容。

cues.text: But Hodgson says, the bigger concern is that certain metrics used in the platform's audio analysis might be culturally biased.
cues.en: But Hodgson says, the bigger concern is that certain metrics used in the platform's audio analysis might be culturally biased.
cues.zh: 但霍奇森表示，更大的擔憂是該平臺音訊分析中使用的某些指標可能存在文化偏見。

cues.text: In other parts of the world, they have musical systems and musical cultures
cues.en: In other parts of the world, they have musical systems and musical cultures
cues.zh: 在世界其他地方，他們有音樂系統和音樂文化

cues.text: that are entirely different.
cues.en: that are entirely different.
cues.zh: 這是完全不同的。

cues.text: Like this North Indian classical track for example.
cues.en: Like this North Indian classical track for example.
cues.zh: 例如，就像這首北印度古典曲目。

cues.text: Spotify's algorithm labels its key signature as E minor
cues.en: Spotify's algorithm labels its key signature as E minor
cues.zh: Spotify 的演演算法將其調號標記為 E 小調

cues.text: which Hodgson says is inappropriate for this musical tradition.
cues.en: which Hodgson says is inappropriate for this musical tradition.
cues.zh: 霍奇森說這不適合這種音樂傳統。

cues.text: However, it's still the case that the music that is emerging from South Asia
cues.en: However, it's still the case that the music that is emerging from South Asia
cues.zh: 然而，從南亞興起的音樂仍然如此

cues.text: is being understood algorithmically, under the Western equal temperament scale.
cues.en: is being understood algorithmically, under the Western equal temperament scale.
cues.zh: 在西方平均律量表下透過演演算法來理解。

cues.text: Spotify says the audio analysis is one small part of the overall system,
cues.en: Spotify says the audio analysis is one small part of the overall system,
cues.zh: Spotify 表示音訊分析只是整個系統的一小部分，

cues.text: which takes into account many factors, before making a recommendation.
cues.en: which takes into account many factors, before making a recommendation.
cues.zh: 在提出建議之前會考慮許多因素。

cues.text: Some industry experts also point to issues with how the system understands metadata
cues.en: Some industry experts also point to issues with how the system understands metadata
cues.zh: 一些行業專家也指出了系統如何理解後設資料的問題

cues.text: for classical music.
cues.en: for classical music.
cues.zh: 對於古典音樂。

cues.text: For example, the metadata for a Tchaikovsky track, can include not just the name of the work and the artist,
cues.en: For example, the metadata for a Tchaikovsky track, can include not just the name of the work and the artist,
cues.zh: 例如，柴可夫斯基曲目的元資料不僅可以包括作品和藝術家的名稱，

cues.text: but also the movement, opus number and conductor.
cues.en: but also the movement, opus number and conductor.
cues.zh: 還包括樂章、作品編號和指揮。

cues.text: Spotify's algorithm isn't optimized for that.
cues.en: Spotify's algorithm isn't optimized for that.
cues.zh: Spotify 的演演算法並未針對這一點進行最佳化。

cues.text: Apple Music, which has emerged in recent years as a competitor to Spotify,
cues.en: Apple Music, which has emerged in recent years as a competitor to Spotify,
cues.zh: Apple Music 近年來作為 Spotify 的競爭對手而崛起，

cues.text: released a new app in March that the company says is designed to solve this problem.
cues.en: released a new app in March that the company says is designed to solve this problem.
cues.zh: 該公司在三月發布了一款新應用程式，稱其旨在解決這個問題。

cues.text: Spotify says it doesn't comment on a competitor's marketing campaigns.
cues.en: Spotify says it doesn't comment on a competitor's marketing campaigns.
cues.zh: Spotify 表示不會對競爭對手的行銷活動發表評論。

cues.text: In February, the streaming service joined the recent buzz, around generative AI.
cues.en: In February, the streaming service joined the recent buzz, around generative AI.
cues.zh: 今年二月，串流媒體服務加入了最近圍繞生成人工智慧的熱潮。

cues.text: I'm X, and from this moment on I'm gonna be your own personal AI DJ on Spotify.
cues.en: I'm X, and from this moment on I'm gonna be your own personal AI DJ on Spotify.
cues.zh: 我是 X，從這一刻起，我將成為您在 Spotify 上的個人 AI DJ。

cues.text: The DJ gives the algorithm a human voice and offers listeners additional context,
cues.en: The DJ gives the algorithm a human voice and offers listeners additional context,
cues.zh: DJ 為演演算法提供人聲並為聽眾提供額外的背景資訊，

cues.text: around a recommendation.
cues.en: around a recommendation.
cues.zh: 圍繞一個推薦。

cues.text: Up next, I know you've been on a summer song kick lately.
cues.en: Up next, I know you've been on a summer song kick lately.
cues.zh: 接下來，我知道你最近很喜歡夏日歌曲。

cues.text: Sultan says, the company is also exploring reinforcement learning,
cues.en: Sultan says, the company is also exploring reinforcement learning,
cues.zh: Sultan 表示，該公司還在探索強化學習，

cues.text: a technique that would allow the recommendation system to learn automatically based on feedback.
cues.en: a technique that would allow the recommendation system to learn automatically based on feedback.
cues.zh: 一種允許推薦系統根據回饋自動學習的技術。

cues.text: It will help with the diversity of their recommendation, it will help with the longer term retention
cues.en: It will help with the diversity of their recommendation, it will help with the longer term retention
cues.zh: 這將有助於他們推薦的多樣性，這將有助於長期保留

cues.text: and we are trying to push the state-of-the-art in each of those, introducing new technologies,
cues.en: and we are trying to push the state-of-the-art in each of those, introducing new technologies,
cues.zh: 我們正在努力推動每項技術的發展，引入新技術，

cues.text: new capabilities and bringing new experiences.
cues.en: new capabilities and bringing new experiences.
cues.zh: 新能力並帶來新體驗。
